claims.paraphrased_fact: Only MOD0 and CONFIG bits9:2 are EEPROM-persistent; MOD1 is not. Exact backing mask is 0x07fc. Factory CONFIG is0x0220.
implementation_constraints: Separate persistent mask0x07fc from volatile writable mask0x0ffc and from source-conflicted SOFT_RESET bit1.
Source-prohibited default one-shot maps to shutdown at startup; never persist MOD1.
Mask derivation is a digital bitwise consequence of explicitly tagged bits, not a silicon measurement.

claims.paraphrased_fact: CONFIG tagged bits, THIGH, TLOW and TEMP_OFFSET have writable EEPROM reset images; defaults0x0220,0x6000,0x8000,0x0000 are factory profile values.
implementation_constraints: Keep arbitrary seeded image separate from factory defaults.
General-call reset loads EEPROM-backed values, including signed nonzero offset.
Do not enlarge this IR into general-purpose EEPROM1/2/3 without a separate task.

claims.paraphrased_fact: With EUN0, programmable-address writes change digital volatile registers without programming EEPROM.
implementation_constraints: Test volatile changes then reset reload of old backing image.
Assert no Busy/program event for ordinary locked write.

claims.paraphrased_fact: EUN1 enables backing programming on writes to programmable locations. Busy is set, readiness is polled, no I2C write should occur before completion. A subsequent general-call reset loads programmed data and clears EUN.
implementation_constraints: Use explicit program-completed event with nonzero before/after observables.
Reject prohibited busy writes as outside contract; do not assert their hardware response is ignore, NACK or exception.
Do not score immediate volatile readback/activation of unlocked writes: it is not specified explicitly.
Avoid temperature conversions while EUN1.

claims.paraphrased_fact: Reset starts approximately1.5ms EEPROM load; CONFIG and limit writes in this initial POR are ignored, reads are allowed, and EEPROM Busy is set while load executes.
implementation_constraints: POR started and POR completed are logical events, not wall-clock simulation.
Verify CONFIG/THIGH/TLOW ignore using nonzero attempted writes and later backing reload.
POR writes to OFF, EUN or scratch EEPROM are not defined by the ignore clause: reject or leave unscored.

claims.paraphrased_fact: EEPROM_UL bit14 mirrors CONFIG bit12; flags indicate EEPROM programming or POR load. Clear only when completion/readiness established.
implementation_constraints: Both mirrors must be1 in active program and POR,0 after corresponding completion.
Read must not clear Busy. Register table reset0 is post-load baseline, not permission to skip active POR phase.

claims.paraphrased_fact: The device responds to general-call address0000000 with eighthbit0 and secondbyte00000110 by resetting registers to power-up values.
implementation_constraints: A semantic general-call event can stand for this accepted frame; no physical ACK, arbitration or wire-timing claim.
General-call then POR completion reloads image and locks EUN.

claims.paraphrased_fact: MOD00 and10 are continuous;10 reads back00. MOD01 instantly aborts active conversion into shutdown. MOD11 starts one-shot; after completion device enters shutdown.
implementation_constraints: Use runtime mode state separately from raw post-one-shot MOD bits.
Unknown automatic-shutdown numeric readback must not be fabricated as01.
Allow explicit MOD01 abort with previously accumulated samples discarded.
Do not assert unsupported AVG/CONV edits, repeated MOD11 or mode changes restart a partial cycle.

claims.paraphrased_fact: AVG0/1/2/3 choose1/8/32/64 conversions; accumulation is batch average, not a running average. Result and DataReady publish only at end of batch. Applies CC and OS.
implementation_constraints: Require exactlyN completed sample events before first publication; test N-1 and N.
OS completion enters shutdown, so N+1 event is unsupported.
Rounding of nonintegral means and precise offset-versus-average pipeline order are not specified.
Use identical or evenly divisible nonsaturating samples for exact mean oracle; saturation tests can use constant samples.

claims.paraphrased_fact: One-shot duration contains active conversion only and is affected by AVG, not CONV; after completion DataReady can be cleared by TEMP or CONFIG read.
implementation_constraints: Sweep CONV0..7 with fixedAVG and assert the same sample count, not identical physical elapsed time.
Completion event is post-linearization sample/result abstraction.

claims.paraphrased_fact: Table7-7 reports CC conversion CYCLE times; rowsCONV0..7 and columnsAVG0..3: [15.5,125,500,1000], [125,125,500,1000], [250,250,500,1000], [500,500,500,1000], four1000, four4000, four8000, four16000 milliseconds.
implementation_constraints: Do not describe the entire table as standalone standby time.
No standby when required averaging active period is longer than requested cycle.
A table lookup check validates transcription only; no physical timer/conversion accuracy proof.

claims.paraphrased_fact: TEMP_OFFSET is signed16 two's-complement with1LSB=7.8125mC, added after linearization; out-of-bound sum shows maximum/minimum result.
implementation_constraints: Decode signed16 before arithmetic; clamp to[-32768,32767], then encode.
Test nonzero positive and negative offset and positive/negative saturation; never wrap.
Do not invent physical temperature or linearization model: injected code is already linearized.
Use uniform sample vectors for saturation to avoid unspecified pipeline ordering.

claims.paraphrased_fact: THIGH/TLOW use signed16 two's complement, sameLSB asTEMP, loaded from backing EEPROM on reset.
implementation_constraints: Compare signed temperature against signed limits; positive/negative cross-zero cases required.
Ordered limits are a benchmark domain guard, not an asserted hardware prohibition for reversed limits.

claims.paraphrased_fact: DataReady sets on completed register update and clears on either TEMP or CONFIG read.
implementation_constraints: Return the pre-clear CONFIG flag value then clear side effect.
TEMP reads clearReady only; they do not acquire the CONFIG alert-clear side effect.

claims.paraphrased_fact: TNA0: >THIGH setsHIGH, <TLOW setsLOW; CONFIG read clears flags. ALERT signal reflectsHIGH orLOW unlessDR_ALERT selectsReady; POL chooses active polarity.
implementation_constraints: Test positive and negative signed thresholds, snapshot-then-clear, and re-arm with a later conversion.
The vague ALERT wording in p15 OS paragraph does not imply unconditionalHIGH/LOW on every OS completion.
Equality does not exceed/fall below thresholds; avoid inventing an unconditional clear at equality.

claims.paraphrased_fact: TNA1:HIGH sets abovehigh and clears belowlow; between/equality preserves hysteresis state;LOW reads0. CONFIG reads do not clearHIGH. ALERT remains until qualifying conversion, not CONFIG/SMBus response.
implementation_constraints: Test assertedHIGH survivingCONFIG read, intermediate and threshold-equality values, then belowlow clear.
DataReady still clears onCONFIG/TEMP inTHERM.
Do not assert unspecified mode-change-time alert flag clearing/recomputation.

claims.paraphrased_fact: Single active conversion has13/15.5/17.5ms min/typ/max under specified conditions; p12 example8conversions is124ms active, Table7-7 uses125ms CC cycle. Programming7ms is typical; POR1.5ms approximate. SoftReset prose duration2ms is separate and source-conflicted.
implementation_constraints: No measured latency claims from logical events.
Do not collapse124ms active into125ms cycle, or treat typ/program/POR figures as guaranteed event deadlines.
